metadata.description: AWOS plugins for AI-native development workflows

plugins.name: awos
plugins.description: Extends AWOS core with AI-readiness auditing: audits a project's AI-readiness across quality dimensions (/awos:ai-readiness-audit); also ships the directly-invocable configure-external-sources skill.

plugins.name: better
plugins.description: Experimental research-backed functional specs: /better:spec forks the core spec flow, fans out codebase, web, and internal-KB research agents before drafting, and blind-verifies the written spec with a context-free reader.

plugins.name: profiler
plugins.description: Profiles /awos:implement runs from Claude Code session transcripts: where wall-clock went (model generation, tools, tests, stalls, idle), per-subagent rates, delegation chains, effort leaks, and a live watch mode that flags hung commands while a run is in progress (/profiler:implement).
